Ranking and privacy

Choose a fictional nickname. No account, email address or real name is required.

  • Starting a ranked voyage requests a one-time run ticket. Completing it sends your nickname and a replay of steering, throttle, frame timing and interceptions to this site's server. The server recalculates the result using the v20 game rules.
  • The public leaderboard shows your nickname, points, voyage time, hull, win/loss, submission time and rank. A nickname is not a verified identity. Each completed ranked voyage is a separate entry.
  • Replay inputs are processed for validation, not stored in the score database. The server stores the verified summary, run ID and replay digest. Hosting providers may retain operational request metadata under their own policies.
  • For abuse prevention, the server stores a keyed hash of the connecting IP address in short-lived rate-limit buckets. It does not store the raw IP in the game database. Operators should run the supplied cleanup regularly. This game includes no analytics trackers.
  • Your nickname and the receipt for your most recently saved voyage (run ID, nickname, score, result and rank at finish) are saved locally to show your position between games. This receipt contains no run token or replay. Clearing site data removes the local receipt. Completed runs waiting for acknowledgment are kept in this browser's IndexedDB, then removed after successful save or permanent rejection. If browser storage is blocked, keep the tab open until saving succeeds. Clearing site data removes unsaved replays.
  • A ranked ticket lasts 30 minutes including pauses. Ranked replay validation supports up to 10 minutes of active play, 100,000 input events and a 4 MiB request. If unavailable or a limit is exceeded, play continues in clearly marked practice mode. Practice and abandoned/restarted voyages are not ranked.
  • Network failure can delay or prevent saving. The result says whether a run is saved, pending or rejected; the leaderboard page can retry pending runs. Server replay checks do not prevent bots, assisted play or nickname impersonation.
  • Old game scores stay separate from verified v20 scores unless the operator explicitly migrates and labels them after checking the old rules.

For removal of a public nickname/result, contact the site operator with the nickname and approximate play time. No contact details are collected in the game.
